title: Some properties of G-SVIEs
summary: In this paper, we investigated the solvability of G-SVIEs under two cases: time-varying Lipschitz coefficients and integral-Lipschitz coefficients. Using the Picard iteration method, we established the existence and uniqueness of solutions to G-SVIEs under these two conditions. Additionally, we prove the continuity of the solution with respect to parameters in parameter-dependent G-SVIEs with Lipschitz coefficients.
